purpose: Verify live reachability, exact actuation, exact reward-variance utility preservation, liveness, and overhead for M4-Shield without examining terminal training quality.
pretraining_gates: Credential-free source, Megatron, protocol, and authorization payload hashes match.
The source archive is traversal-safe and contains the frozen runtime, config, analyzers, and tests.
The frozen offline result authenticates and reports PASS_M4_SHIELD_DEVELOPMENT_QUALIFICATION.
Focused OARS-v2 controller tests, config tests, and M4-Shield analyzer tests pass in the runtime image.
The resolved configuration exactly matches this design and the pinned TransferQueue commit.
terminal_gate: Learner versions 1 through 64 complete with exactly one decision per update.
Every decision has the exact eight-candidate controlled frontier and four selected groups.
The reward-variance base proposal and M4-Shield proposal both use exact 70-combination search with zero skips or fallbacks.
Every M4-Shield proposal retains at least two base-proposal groups, stays inside the FIFO-relative token band, and exactly preserves base imminent and total reward variance.
Every non-base intervention strictly increases imminent registered L1 relative to the reward-variance base proposal.
Every configured M4-Shield proposal is exactly enacted and at least one non-base shield intervention occurs.
Liveness accounting is complete, nondecreasing, and reconciles with lifecycle removals; no positive removal event is required.
Combined observer/controller duty is at most one percent and runtime is at most 14400 seconds.
stop_rules: This design authorizes one submission attempt only.
No automatic retry, replacement, extension, or quality acquisition.
Zero live shield interventions is a terminal qualification failure, not a systems pass.
A failure is terminal unless the user separately authorizes a scientifically justified repair.
